newsitem.title: USA: Optical Security names Turnage president.
newsitem.headline: Optical Security names Turnage president.

text.p: Optical Security Group Inc said Wednesday that it has named Mark Turnage president and chief operating officer of the company, effective July 1.
For the past two years Turnage has served as the managing director of the company's international operations, based in London.
He succeeds Richard Bard, who left the office of president, but remains as chief executive officer and chairman of the board of directors.

OpSec's imaging technology is employed in tamper-evident packaging labels; authenticating labels and tags for consumer product protection; and, protection against counterfeiting of documents of value, checks and cards. The Company's holographic imaging and dimensional printing technologies also provide added value in product promotion, point-of-sale and packaging enhancement.
